blockers.summary: Commercial server, telemetry-ingest, jobs and executor share the geox_runtime_v1 database principal; telemetry-ingest and executor share one MQTT credential and broker authority is not direction-isolated.

protected_invariants: MCFT-CAP-07 role names, bootstrap implementation, migration authority and runtime startup preflight remain byte-unchanged.
The long-running server remains authenticated to PostgreSQL as the frozen geox_runtime_v1 role.
telemetry-ingest, jobs and executor receive distinct PostgreSQL LOGIN principals with distinct credentials and no membership in the MCFT owner, migrator or runtime roles.

W6-B2 database principals receive an effective object privilege baseline equivalent to the pre-existing runtime workload baseline for compatibility, but identity, session_user, credential rotation and revocation boundaries are independent.
W6-B2 database principals are NOINHERIT, NOSUPERUSER, NOCREATEDB, NOCREATEROLE, NOREPLICATION and NOBYPASSRLS, and receive no CREATE privilege on public schema.
A separate B-Line one-shot commercial-principal bootstrap runs only after the canonical MCFT-CAP-07 migration completes; it is not imported into the long-running server or any worker.
Commercial MQTT remains anonymous-disabled and uses multiple dedicated broker credentials rather than one shared credential.
telemetry-ingest MQTT principal may read telemetry/+/+ and heartbeat/+/+ but may not publish.
executor MQTT principal may publish but may not subscribe; publish authority remains broad enough to preserve the existing explicit custom downlink-topic contract.
server and jobs receive no MQTT credential unless source-level consumption is proven.
telemetry-ingest and jobs receive no shared GEOX_AO_ACT_TOKEN unless a source-level HTTP caller is proven; executor retains only its dedicated executor token.
W1 through W6-B1 protected authority semantics remain unchanged.

executor.reason_for_broad_write: Existing device integration contract permits explicit custom downlink_topic overrides; W6-B2 isolates direction and identity without narrowing that established topic contract.
